summary: This file exports a custom set of components for MDX (a markdown extension that lets you write React components in markdown files). It takes all the default MDX components and adds or overrides the Image component with a custom version from the project.

explanations.6: The three dots (...) spread operator copies all the properties from MDXComponents into this new object, so we inherit all the default markdown components.
explanations.7: This shorthand (Image instead of Image: Image) assigns the custom Image component to the export, which will override any default Image component from MDXComponents if one existed.
